about: A Saudi transport company's chart with Arabic account names. The first twenty rows carry the account class in English, as a bilingual ledger export does; the last two carry it in Arabic, as a ledger kept only in Arabic does. Every row is read, names and classes both -- including طويل الاجل as long-term debt and مكافاة نهاية الخدمة as a non-current liability.
source: Invented, in the shape a Saudi trading company's ledger export has.
